notes.title: 🔴 Live: Soccering Together
notes.notes:
I will be available to chat with you, answer to your questions and listen to your suggestions while playing Soccering. By the way, have you heard that my games are completely made using only free tools (open-source)? Come check out this and much more!

Thanks for your support!
Take care!
André Nardelli

notes.title: Soccering Released - 40% off!
notes.notes:
This last Early Access update brings [b]4 new achievements[/b], a [b]new song[/b] (Press the square brackets to navigate between tracks), the option of [b]muting music[/b] or [b]soundFx[/b] and several bug fixes. Enjoy it :)

Even with the end of EA, please fell free to continue [b]sharing your ideas and suggestions[/b], so we can keep improving the game together!

Thank you all for supporting Soccering <3
André Nardelli

notes.title: Change in the Keyboard Controls mapping!
notes.notes:
Hello Guys,

I've listened to you and I've changed the mapping of keyboard controls to please the majority of the players - that are used to playing with the WASD system.

From now on:

[list]
[*] Keyboard Mode 1 = WASD + Space (Default)
[*] Keyboard Mode 2 = Arrows + Enter (KeyPad Enter as well)
[/list]

Thanks for your support!
GDS
